notes: K5: none of the 13 technician-made heads was ever powered or electrically tested (no USB source or permitted socket was found); only visual and mechanical checks, so there are no opportunities. K6: actual_min runs from pickup/boarding to arrival, compared with the app trip duration. Worker-b's Sunday ride home (quote 346/51 min) is left out because no arrival time is given. K3 is counted once per shop: Harby's later yeses (three extra heads Thu, head 13 Sun) are noted but not counted separately. K1: the Lampatronics 'within an hour' joining claim is counted as K1, not K4, following the guide's example. FEC part specs were never powered, so they are marked unclear. K2: at Thabet the first item shown was 500 EGP, but suitable 180 EGP stands were found at the same counter, so it is marked false. OTG and power bank are grouped as one item per shop, and tape/Velcro/straps as one. Later repeat asks at the same shop for the same item (Lampatronics sets, El Tamimi arms) are not counted again. K7: the Fares and Most calls gave firm refusals on services (table/testing; delivery), so they are counted as usable answers under the guide's 'firm yes or no' wording. Neither gave a usable price.
